errors.text: The required SRO finite-size boundary is not specified: the target uses a 12×12×12, 3456-atom supercell over 2000–2400 K.
The hypothesis describes melting-temperature accuracy in meV/atom; 0.5 meV/atom is a free-energy agreement criterion, not a temperature-error metric.

The cited evidence does not validate MTP+FEP free energies, sub-meV accuracy, or an 80% cost reduction. The cited MoNbTaW MTP has an energy MAE of about 4.4 meV/atom, which does not establish the target training-error threshold below 1 meV/atom.
